name: Yes No
subtitle: Simple yes & no, for everyone
promotional_text: A calm, ad-free AAC app that gives a voice to yes and no. Made for children and non-verbal users.
description:
Yes No is the simplest augmentative and alternative communication (AAC) app: two big, friendly buttons — Yes and No.

Built for children and anyone who needs a clear, frustration-free way to be heard, Yes No speaks the choice out loud and shows it on screen. No accounts required to start, no ads, no clutter.

- Tap Yes or No to speak the answer instantly
- Works offline — the app is ready the moment it opens
- Optional, parent-managed account to recover answers across devices
- Child mode keeps the screen focused and distraction-free

Yes No is part of Tiko, a child-first universe of small, focused AAC tools.
